entry.name: serverUrl
entry.label: Address of the Savings server, e.g. http://192.168.0.10:8090

entry.name: token
entry.label: Widget token from Savings → Settings → KDE widget

entry.name: refreshMinutes
entry.label: How often to refresh, in minutes

entry.name: showPerDay
entry.label: Show the per-day amount in the panel

entry.name: panelShows
entry.label: What the panel shows: left, perday, spent, budget or icon

entry.name: panelStyle
entry.label: Panel text: plain (€1,820), labeled (€1,820 left) or twoLine

entry.name: panelBar
entry.label: Mini bar under the panel number: off, period or budget

entry.name: numberColor
entry.label: Colour the panel number: off, over (red when over) or traffic (green / amber / red)

entry.name: panelIcon
entry.label: Panel icon: logo, mono (follows the panel theme) or none

entry.name: privacy
entry.label: Hide amounts until hovered (panel) or clicked (popup)

entry.name: primaryTab
entry.label: Which popup tab opens first: overview or budget

entry.name: sections
entry.label: Popup sections in order, comma-separated

entry.name: hiddenSections
entry.label: Popup sections not shown, comma-separated

entry.name: whereChart
entry.label: Where it went: doughnut or bars

entry.name: trendPeriods
entry.label: Spent vs income: how many periods (3, 6 or 12)

entry.name: showFuture
entry.label: Show future-dated spending in the charts

entry.name: density
entry.label: Popup density: comfortable or compact

entry.name: popupSize
entry.label: Popup size: small, medium or large

entry.name: numberFormat
entry.label: Number format: en (€1,820.30) or eu (€1.820,30)

entry.name: wholeEuros
entry.label: Round to whole euros

entry.name: notifyInvites
entry.label: Notify about invitations to shared categories

entry.name: notifyShared
entry.label: Notify about changes in shared categories (joins, leaves, shares, moderation)

entry.name: notifyReset
entry.label: Notify a few days before the budget period resets

entry.name: notifyRecurring
entry.label: Notify when a recurring payment is added

entry.name: notifyBudgets
entry.label: Notify when a category reaches 90 % or goes over its budget

entry.name: seenNotifications
entry.label: Notifications already shown (ids, comma-separated)

entry.name: notificationsPrimed
entry.label: The first check has run (older events were marked as seen, not shown)

entry.name: cache
entry.label: Last summary received (shown while the server can't be reached)
